item.title: In 1952, Mary Tsingou programmed a Los Alamos experiment that helped change modern physics
item.description: In the 1950s, Mary Tsingou Menzel played a pivotal role in solving a complex physics problem using one of the earliest computers. Initially recognized only in a footnote for her computational work, her contributions to the Fermi-Pasta-Ulam problem have since gained fitting recognition. A true trailblazer in computational physics, she worked silently yet effectively in the realm of national security science. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
